title: Parameter Estimation for Complex α-Fractional Brownian Bridge
summary: We study the statistical inference problem for a complex $α$-fractional Brownian bridge process $Z$ defined by the stochastic differential equation \[ \mathrm{d}Z_t = -α\frac{Z_t}{T - t} \mathrm{d}t + \mathrm{d}ζ_t, \quad t \in [0, T), \] with initial condition $Z_0 = 0$, where $α= λ- \sqrt{-1}w$, $λ> 0$, $w \in \mathbb{R}$ and $ζ_t$ is a complex fractional Brownian motion.
